description: This file defines the LocalVectorStore class, which provides an interface for creating, managing, and querying a FAISS-based vector index for embeddings, including adding, searching, saving, loading, and retrieving statistics.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class encapsulating FAISS index operations for vector similarity search, including adding embeddings, searching, saving/loading index, and retrieving statistics.

methods.name: __init__(self, dimension: int = 3072)
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with a specified dimension and creates a FAISS index.

methods.name: None add_embeddings( self, embeddings: List[List[float]], metadata_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Adds a list of embeddings along with metadata to the index.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] search( self, query_embedding: List[float], k: int = 5, filter_chapter: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Performs a similarity search for a given query embedding, returning top-k results with optional chapter filtering.

methods.name: None save(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Saves the FAISS index and metadata to disk at the specified path.

methods.name: bool load(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Loads the FAISS index and metadata from disk from the specified path.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_stats(self)
methods.description: Returns statistics about the current state of the vector store, including total vectors, dimension, and metadata count.

ctags.signature: ( self, embeddings: List[List[float]], metadata_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
